description: State machines of the generation domain. Every state change commits in the same transaction as the row version bump and the event it emits (events.json). `actor` is USER (HTTP command), WORKER (step execution), SERVER (derived or detected inside a command or the worker) or RETENTION (retention worker). `from: null` is creation. Authority: docs/architecture/ai-generation-platform.md sections 3 and 4. Reads (getSession, getArtifact, listEvents, listActiveSessions) never change state: a source drift is detected by the worker or by approve, never by a GET.

kindSupport.EXERCISES: AI-13 (planFirst runs the planner since AI-14, #295: decision 17)
kindSupport.REVISE_ITEM: AI-16 (#294): one artifact (target ITEM) that starts as a copy of the material's head and is rewritten whole by one FREE turn; approval is a revise of that material
kindSupport.REVISE_EXERCISE: AI-16 (#294): one artifact (target EXERCISE) that starts as a copy of the exercise's head, rewritten by an EDIT turn and/or its audio redone by a media turn (Stub speech executor until AI-09, #297); approval is a revision of that exercise

endReason.meaning: Session-level field set when a session enters CANCELLED (USER_CANCELLED, PLAN_FAILED) or EXPIRED; null otherwise. A cancelled session that later becomes CLOSED keeps USER_CANCELLED.

PLANNING.description: Only when the planner is enabled and the spec asks for a plan first: the PLAN step is running; no artifacts exist yet. Two holds are taken at creation: the batch exactly as without the plan, and the plan's own price.

PLAN_READY.description: The plan is shown to the user for editing; nothing is generated and no credits beyond the plan are spent (the plan itself was debited when it became ready, apart from the batch). The batch hold is not renewed here and lapses after learning.usage.reservation-ttl.

RUNNING.description: At least one artifact is QUEUED or GENERATING. A REVISE_ITEM or REVISE_EXERCISE session is RUNNING from its creation (its artifact is REVISING, the first turn is queued) until that turn ends (the artifact is PROPOSED again), then REVIEW; later turns (a repeat, a voice change) happen in REVIEW.

REVIEW.description: No artifact is QUEUED or GENERATING and at least one is PROPOSED, REVISING, STALE or a retryable FAILED (errorCode other than REFUSAL); the user reviews, edits, approves and retries. FAILED artifacts keep the session here so a retry or undo stays possible.

CLOSED.description: No artifact is PROPOSED, REVISING, STALE, QUEUED, GENERATING or retryable FAILED: the rest is PUBLISHED, HANDED_OFF, REJECTED or FAILED with errorCode REFUSAL (not retryable). Not purged yet: only an undo of a rejection reopens it (CLOSED to REVIEW, or to CANCELLED for a cancelled session); the client offers to archive used notes (N). REJECTED and REFUSAL leftovers do not keep a session open.

CANCELLED.description: The user stopped the session or the PLAN step failed (endReason). Waiting steps are CANCELLED, unfinished artifacts (QUEUED or GENERATING) are FAILED with errorCode CANCELLED; artifacts already PROPOSED can still be approved, rejected, handed off or stripped of media, but nothing new is generated. Ends as CLOSED when no PROPOSED, REVISING or STALE artifact remains.

EXPIRED.description: expires_at (last activity + learning.generation.session-retention) passed while the session was not closed. Readable until the retention worker purges it, then 404.

retention.purge: At expires_at the retention worker moves a live session (PLANNING, PLAN_READY, RUNNING, REVIEW) to EXPIRED, which stays readable for learning.generation.retention.expired-readable (P1D); then it deletes the unpublished rows of the session: artifacts, revisions, turns, slots, media holds, steps and events, and releases its credit holds. CLOSED and CANCELLED sessions are deleted at their expires_at directly. Published refs stay in the catalog, handed-off drafts in the editor, provenance for audit.
retention.events: generation_event rows are kept until the session is closed (or cancelled or expired) plus P1D (learning.generation.retention.events-after-end, architecture section 5), then deleted; the purge deletes them with the session. Three days before expires_at (retention.warn-before) the owner gets GENERATION_SESSION_EXPIRING while PROPOSED, REVISING or STALE artifacts remain.
retention.afterPurge: getSession, getArtifact, listEvents and deleteSession answer 404. An EXPIRED session is readable only until the worker purges it.

limits.activeCounting: The 3-session limit counts PLANNING, PLAN_READY, RUNNING and REVIEW sessions that still have a PROPOSED, REVISING or STALE artifact. A REVIEW session that holds only FAILED or REJECTED leftovers does NOT count (its batch reservation is already released at REVIEW entry). listActiveSessions still lists every REVIEW session, because the user can retry there.
limits.note: See activeCounting for what counts toward the active-session limit. The 60 for EXERCISES is owner decision 2026-10-02 (see README); the architecture says 20 per session.

session.versioning: session rowVersion bumps on every row change (state, pointers, last activity). It is exposed as ETag for reads; the one session command that takes it is approvePlan (body member expectedSessionVersion).

operationNotes.editArtifact: In a CANCELLED session only action REMOVE_MEDIA is accepted (no new steps).
operationNotes.cancelSession: State-idempotent and needs no If-Match: cancelling a CANCELLED session answers 200 with the current state; a CLOSED or EXPIRED one answers 409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT.
operationNotes.deleteSession: Needs no If-Match; the first call answers 204, later calls 404.

QUEUED.description: Waiting for a worker to claim the generating step.

GENERATING.description: A TEXT_DRAFT (or exercise draft) step is running; BLOCKS_APPENDED checkpoints may arrive.

PROPOSED.description: A valid revision is the current proposal; the user can approve (when every slot is READY or REMOVED), edit, reject or hand off.

REVISING.description: An edit or media redo is running against the current revision; the current proposal stays readable.

FAILED.description: Retries are exhausted or the failure is not retryable; errorCode explains. The user can retry unless the errorCode is REFUSAL.

REJECTED.description: Disapproved by the user; reversible by undo while the session is not CLOSED.

STALE.description: A pinned source changed after generation (reason SOURCE_STALE). For an EXERCISE the server first re-pins by stable node IDs without a model call (approval, decision 14 of the README): when every quoted node still reads as text in the new revision and the exercise passes its checks again it stays PROPOSED with repinStatus AUTO_REPINNED and the approval goes on; otherwise (a node vanished, the material is gone, a check fails, or the exercise was edited by the owner) it becomes STALE with repinStatus NEEDS_USER_DECISION and the user decides: reject, hand off (an ITEM: edit the stale proposal oneself) or retry (regenerate against the new source revision). There is no 'keep anyway' approve.

PUBLISHED.description: Approved: published into the catalog in the same transaction. publishedRef points at the item or exercise.

HANDED_OFF.description: Opened in the editor as an EditingDraft; the artifact no longer changes.

errorCodes.INVALID_OUTPUT: Output failed compiler or lint after one repair and the strong route.
errorCodes.REFUSAL: The model refused; not retried and not retryable by the user.
errorCodes.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A pinned note or material is gone.
errorCodes.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Transient failures exhausted all routes, or the circuit is open.
errorCodes.USAGE_LIMIT: The user's limit (credit bar, cap or daily burst) cannot cover the call; no provider call was made. Waiting or a plan change helps.
errorCodes.ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED: The call would exceed the reservation made from the estimate (under-reservation); no provider call was made. A retry reserves again.
errorCodes.CANCELLED: The session was cancelled before the artifact finished (also for artifacts that were still QUEUED).
errorCodes.PLAN_FAILED: Session-level: the PLAN step failed (see endReason).

mediaSlotErrorCodes.NO_RESULT: A search returned nothing usable (no licensed image found); also the slot of a media node that a revert restored after its REMOVE_MEDIA (the asset is no longer held, so the media must be added again or removed).
mediaSlotErrorCodes.VERIFICATION_REJECTED: The media pipeline (#76) rejected the staged bytes.
mediaSlotErrorCodes.USAGE_LIMIT: The user's limit does not cover the redo.
mediaSlotErrorCodes.ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED: The redo would exceed its reservation.

artifact.note: An operation is allowed only when both the artifact state (here) and the session state (session.allowedOperations) allow it; otherwise the response is 409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT, except editArtifact on a REVISING artifact, which is 409 EDIT_IN_PROGRESS, and an approval of a STALE artifact, which is 409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT with reason SOURCE_STALE.

READY.description: Claimable when next_attempt_at <= now and a capability slot is free. A step deferred by the daily burst sits here with next_attempt_at at the next day start.

RUNNING.description: Claimed with a lease token; the heartbeat renews the lease; no database transaction is open during the provider call.

WAITING_EXTERNAL.description: A provider job id is stored; the step is polled until the external job ends or its deadline passes. Polling increments poll_count, never attempts.

SUCCEEDED.description: Result stored by a short separate transaction that also debits usage.

FAILED.description: error_code stored; no usage debit for provider-side failures.

counters.attempts: Incremented by every claim (READY to RUNNING); bounds retries.
counters.poll_count: Incremented by every poll of a WAITING_EXTERNAL step; bounded by the step deadline, not by the attempt cap.

turn.description: generation_artifact_turn: one user instruction on an artifact (at most 2000 characters, text or speech transcript; at most 50 per artifact). REMOVE_MEDIA is also recorded as a turn (cause MEDIA, creates a revision) but does not count toward the 50. A turn is made by editArtifact and listed by getArtifact (turns). Of a REVISE_EXERCISE session an exercise turn is FREE (the whole exercise, no target nodes) or AUDIO_REGENERATE (with a voice; its step is kind TTS): when a spec has both, the media turn is created when the rewrite is APPLIED (its step waits in WAITING_DEPENDENCIES) and is never created when the rewrite fails.

QUEUED.description: Accepted; the EDIT step is not running yet.

FAILED.description: No new revision; the artifact returned to PROPOSED. errorCode is one of artifact.errorCodes.

CANCELLED.description: Stopped by a session cancellation or by a retry of the artifact. Reject and revert are not allowed while a turn is running, so they never cancel one.

transitions.guard: no other turn QUEUED or RUNNING on the artifact

transitions.trigger: EDIT step expired before a worker claimed it (queue timeout), or lost its lease before the turn started
transitions.note: errorCode DEADLINE_EXCEEDED or PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; the hold is released unspent and the artifact is PROPOSED again.

imageSearchErrorCodes.NO_RESULT: No new commercially usable image was found (or none passed verification).

mediaSlot.description: generation_media_slot: one media directive of the document. The slot key is stable across revisions of an artifact. errorCode is one of artifact.mediaSlotErrorCodes. The slots of an artifact follow the revision that is shown: each is attached to the current revision when its node is in that document. An IMAGE slot of mode search keeps its candidates (generation_media_candidate, AI-10): the initial step stages one, each IMAGE_SEARCH turn up to 4 more, at most 12; selectMediaCandidate re-points the slot to another READY candidate in a new revision (cause MEDIA).

PENDING.description: Compiled; the child step has not started.

GENERATING.description: TTS, image or video step running (including WAITING_EXTERNAL).

VERIFYING.description: Bytes are staged in the media pipeline (#76) and verified like an upload.

READY.description: Asset READY; the renderer shows the media.

FAILED.description: Step or verification failed; errorCode explains; the user can redo or remove.

REMOVED.description: The user explicitly removed the media (or a revision without the node became the current one); the node is gone from the proposal. Counts as resolved for approve. Only a revert to a revision that still holds the node leaves this state (to FAILED).
